courses: Focus: LLMs, VLMs, Post-Training (SFT & RL), Agentic Systems, AI for Software Engineering, Security, Privacy

projects.name: RL for Multimodal Reasoning
highlights: Designed reinforcement learning experiments to improve VLM math problem solving, yielding gains across math, science, and general reasoning tasks

projects.name: RL for LLM Vulnerability Repair
highlights: Designed VRPO, a reinforcement learning framework leveraging formal verification to improve LLM capabilities on generating functionally correct and secure patches by 2x
Engineered a multi-GPU and multi-node distributed GRPO training pipeline using verl and DeepSpeed on an HPC cluster, achieving 4x speedup
Curated a verifiable code dataset of security and functionality tests for training and evaluation using a code agent system

projects.name: Privacy-Respecting LLM System
highlights: Co-developed NOIR, a distributed LLM system using differential privacy to prevent 100% of prompt and response reconstruction attacks
Reduced NOIR's inference latency by 3x by creating a distributed inference system using Ray, modifying vLLM with CUDA, and high-throughput gRPC packet transfer

projects.name: Secure Code Generation System
highlights: Developed SGCode, an LLM system for secure code generation with static analysis
Conducted analysis showing up to 90% functionality deviation on vulnerability patches by LLMs

projects.name: Mobile Agentic Systems
highlights: Co-designed an agentic system that leverages VLMs to predict and perform user intentions on mobile devices
Developed an end-to-end mobile application to collect real-world usage data

projects.name: Cellular Network Maintenance Scheduling
highlights: Designed a graph foundation model to predict cellular site maintenance, optimizing for both operational efficiency and user experience
Processed and analyzed large-scale historical LTE and 5G network data to train and evaluate scheduling systems
